nameEn: Retail sale of carpets, rugs, wall and floor coverings in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of floor coverings and wall coverings in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of carpets, rugs, mats
retail sale of linoleum and other hard floor coverings
retail sale of wallpaper and wall coverings
retail sale of curtains and blinds
excludes: retail sale of soft textiles and household linen, see 4751
